name: pm-column-designer
description: Modular web platform for reinforced concrete column P-M-M section design.

scripts.dev: npm run check:runtime && npm run dev -w @pm/web
scripts.start: npm run check:runtime && npm run start -w @pm/web
scripts.build: npm run check:runtime && npm run build -w @pm/web
scripts.lint: npm run check:runtime && npm run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run check:runtime && npm run check:structure && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:adsec && npm run test:cad && npm run test:roundtrip && npm run test:excel-export && npm run test:excel-block && npm run test:demand-check && npm run test:pdf-report
scripts.test:unit: npm run check:runtime && node --import tsx --test tools/runtime/*.test.mjs packages/pm-results/test/*.test.ts packages/pm-equivalent-block/test/*.test.ts packages/pm-code-kds142020/test/*.test.ts packages/pm-code-aci318/test/*.test.ts packages/pm-code-en1992/test/*.test.ts packages/pm-code-as3600/test/*.test.ts packages/pm-code-custom/test/*.test.ts packages/pm-materials/test/*.test.ts packages/pm-design/test/*.test.ts packages/pm-geometry/test/*.test.ts packages/pm-stations/test/*.test.ts packages/pm-project/test/*.test.ts packages/pm-analysis-equivalent-block/test/*.test.ts packages/pm-analysis/test/*.test.ts packages/pm-report/test/*.test.ts apps/web/test/*.test.ts apps/web/test/analysis/*.test.ts apps/web/test/geometry/*.test.ts apps/web/test/results/*.test.ts
scripts.test:adsec: npm run check:runtime && node --import tsx --test tools/verification/adsec/*.test.ts
scripts.test:cad: npm run check:runtime && npm run test -w @structures/cad-drawing
scripts.bench:verify:portable: npm run check:runtime && tsx packages/pm-analysis/bench/run.ts --repeats 1 --baseline packages/pm-analysis/bench/baselines/capacity-baseline.json --comparison portable
